decisions: The arcade loop, local leaderboard, achievements, audio, and persistence remain offchain browser functionality.
No Ritual precompile or smart contract is essential for version one.
Wallet connection is optional identity only and never gates gameplay.
Ritual Testnet configuration is centralized from the official skill values.
Remote fonts were replaced with local font stacks so production builds are deterministic and offline-safe.
The reference site informed only the simple three-lane gameplay rhythm; no source, layout, assets, colors, branding, or dimensions were copied.
The latest supplied direction supersedes phase 8: the Ritual logo is now used proportionally for both the player and every obstacle, while the shield remains a distinct energy orb.
The Vercel deployment publishes the browser application.
The user requested an on-chain Ritual public testnet phase after the initial offchain release.
The RitualRush contract is ownerless and records explicitly unverified public score claims without custody, tokens, or privileged administration.

The v2 registry is deployed to Ritual Testnet so the local preview can exercise real wallet transactions; the browser bundle remains preview-gated with no repository push or Vercel deployment before approval.
